application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of an outbuilding at the rear of the rear garden with an extended roof covering.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1215 - 02 - 00; 1215 - 02 - 01; 1215 - 02 - 01.2; 1215 - 02 - 02; 1215 - 02 - 03; 1215 - 02 - 04; 1215 - 02 - 05; 1215 - 02 - 06; 1215 - 02 - 07  Received:  27 April 2021;  1215 - 01 - 00; 1215 - 01 - 01  Received: 04 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rear outbuilding and associated covered BBQ area hereby approved shall be constructed with timber clad walls, a flat roof and matching aluminium, UPVC or painted timber windows, doors and roof lights.  The raised decking hereby approved to be installed around the existing rear outdoor swimming pool shall be constructed with timber decking.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear outbuilding and attached covered BBQ area hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at 2 Chatsworth Road, W4 3HY.  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
